screenshots.title: Measurement takeoff
screenshots.alt: GridScalr showing a calibrated industrial floor plan with warehouse, office and workshop measurements and the Properties panel.
screenshots.description: A calibrated industrial takeoff with rectangle areas, counts, a deduction and drawing annotations.

screenshots.title: Measure and annotate
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with the Length tool active, the Layers panel open and the context bar showing the target layer and New measurement options, with Properties on the right.
screenshots.description: Measurement and drawing tools share one canvas but stay on separate layer types.

screenshots.title: Markups and layers
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel with a revision cloud around a loading dock, a callout at the entrance and an inspected stamp.
screenshots.description: Revision clouds, callouts and status stamps live on drawing layers.

screenshots.title: Expanded layer items
screenshots.alt: GridScalr Layers panel with page-scoped layers, a measurement layer expanded to show items on the current page, and the Add/Deduct switch in the context bar.
screenshots.description: Expand a layer to inspect every item, select it on the plan and choose additive or deduction areas.

screenshots.title: Quantities
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Quantities dialog showing gross, deduction, net, waste and order quantities by category and room.
screenshots.description: Live quantities with deductions, waste and rounding for procurement.

screenshots.title: Markups list
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Markups panel with a saved Room review view, building, floor and room groups, and the Name, Type, Page, Layer, Value, Category and Room columns.
screenshots.description: A docked, project-wide list with saved views, configurable columns, grouping, filters, and row navigation.

screenshots.title: Symbol library
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr symbol library opened from the tool rail, with searchable fire, evacuation, HVAC, electrical, building and waste symbols, a selected extinguisher on the plan and Markups grouped by symbol category and status.
screenshots.description: Place vector facility symbols with category colours, rotation and inspection status, then review them in the Markups list.

screenshots.title: Drawing export
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Drawing PDF export dialog with page range, crop area, layer selection, labels and legend options.
screenshots.description: Export visible markups as a flattened drawing PDF without modifying the source drawing.

screenshots.title: Reference view
screenshots.alt: GridScalr with a primary editable canvas and a read-only reference pane showing the same calibrated floor plan at the same pan and zoom, with a source selector for Same page, Revision and Drawing.
screenshots.description: A read-only reference pane follows the primary canvas while keeping edits, selection and undo in one place. Switch its source between the same page, a saved revision or a raw PDF drawing.

screenshots.title: Revision or drawing comparison
screenshots.alt: GridScalr comparing the current takeoff with a reference revision in overlay mode, with a differences panel showing changed, added and removed items.
screenshots.description: Load a reference revision without merging it, switch between side-by-side and overlay, and export a comparison PDF. A raw PDF drawing reference keeps the visuals and export without a markup diff.

screenshots.title: Full-text search
screenshots.alt: GridScalr search panel with a text query, page results and a highlighted match on the drawing.
screenshots.description: Search the PDF text layer across every page and jump to a highlighted result.

screenshots.title: Workflows in the help dialog
screenshots.alt: The GridScalr Help dialog open on the Workflows tab with guides for operations technicians and technical property managers.
screenshots.description: Task-oriented workflows sit beside the full user guide, shortcuts and About.
